title: Learning from Five Years of the 5x5x5 Russo Student Investment Fund
summary:
Our first conversation
is going to be a little different as we’ll be talking about this
year’s picks for the 5x5x5 Russo Student Investment Fund. Joining
me today is Tom Russo, who designed and funded this first-ever
student investment fund at Columbia Business School in 2014, and
students James Shen and Freda Zhuo, whose portfolio picks have
performed particularly well. The 5x5x5 fund is run by the students of the Value Investing
course at Columbia Business School, with ideas being submitted by
the students each year.
